name: Banana Oat Breakfast Bowl
description: Creamy stovetop oats topped with caramelized banana — a 10-minute breakfast that keeps you full till lunch.

steps.title: Simmer the oats
steps.description: Combine oats and milk in a small pot. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.

steps.title: Stir until creamy
steps.description: Stir often for 3–4 minutes until thick and creamy.

steps.title: Slice the banana
steps.description: While the oats cook, slice the banana into thin rounds.

steps.title: Assemble & finish
steps.description: Pour oats into a bowl, top with banana, a drizzle of honey and a pinch of cinnamon.

name: Overnight Oats & Berries
description: No cooking required — layer it at night, wake up to a ready breakfast.

steps.title: Mix the base
steps.description: Stir oats, yogurt, milk and chia together in a jar.

steps.title: Layer & chill
steps.description: Top with berries, seal and refrigerate overnight (8 h).

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Give it a stir and eat cold, or warm briefly if you prefer.

name: 2-Ingredient Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Fluffy flourless pancakes from just banana and oats — naturally sweet.

steps.title: Blend
steps.description: Blend banana, oats, egg and baking powder into a smooth batter.

steps.title: Heat the pan
steps.description: Warm a non-stick pan over medium-low with a little oil.

steps.title: Cook the pancakes
steps.description: Pour small rounds, cook 2 min per side until golden.

steps.title: Serve warm
steps.description: Stack and top with fruit or yogurt.

name: Savory Oat & Veg Porridge
description: Oats aren't only for breakfast — a savory, cozy bowl with vegetables.

steps.title: Simmer in stock
steps.description: Cook oats in vegetable stock for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add greens
steps.description: Stir in spinach until wilted.

steps.title: Top with egg
steps.description: Add a soft-boiled or fried egg on top, season and serve.

name: Peanut Oat Energy Balls
description: No-bake bites for a quick, portable snack.

steps.title: Mix
steps.description: Combine all ingredients into a sticky dough.

steps.title: Roll
steps.description: Roll into small balls.

steps.title: Chill
steps.description: Refrigerate 30 minutes to firm up.

name: Chicken & Oat Meatballs
description: Oats replace breadcrumbs for tender, high-protein meatballs.

steps.title: Mix the mince
steps.description: Combine chicken, oats, egg, minced garlic and seasoning.

steps.title: Shape
steps.description: Roll into even meatballs.

steps.title: Sear
steps.description: Brown in a hot pan on all sides.

steps.title: Finish in sauce
steps.description: Simmer in tomato sauce until cooked through, 15 min.
